$comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen/contracts.gen.mjs (npm run gen). Do not edit. A diff here means the wire contract changed: update docs/spec/PROTOCOL.md too.

cancelTask.summary: Cancels a queued or in-progress order (refunds 75 % if in progress and cancels linked prep, UO-Q-02 / UO-TF-03).

demolish.summary: Demolishes an owned finished structure and refunds 50 % of its cost while keeping tiles Prepared (UO-Q-02, W02-09).

dev.cell.summary: Dev console: sets the colony HQ power cell energy to `energy` (clamped to cell capacity).

dev.fill.summary: Dev console: fills a resource (or family / all T1 resources) up to its colony family storage cap (W02-30).

dev.grant.summary: Dev console: adds or subtracts `amount` of `resource` on the caller colony (clamped to >= 0).

dev.land.summary: Dev console: respawns or lands the caller colony drop pod and HQ at a spawn slot.

dev.nudge.summary: Moves a test entity by dev.probe.nudgeTiles tiles along (dq, dr); default direction +q.

dev.ping.summary: No-op command that round-trips through the sim; acked with the tick it was applied at.

dev.power.summary: Dev console: dumps the colony power grid component balance and shed states (W02-30).

dev.reveal.summary: Dev console: marks every tile explored for the caller colony.

dev.seed.summary: Dev console: regenerates the dev planet terrain with the given seed.

dev.skipnight.summary: Dev console: advances the planet clock to sunrise if currently in night (W02-30).

dev.spawn.summary: Inserts the W00 test entity (kind 1) at tile (q, r); x/y are the tile centre in axial float coordinates.

dev.teleport.summary: Sets a test entity position directly to tile (q, r).

dev.time.summary: Dev console: sets the planet day/night clock to `day`, `night`, or `hh:mm` (W02-30).

enqueueTask.summary: Enqueues a terraform order (W01), a building construction order (W02), or a unit production order (W02) in the colony queue.

moveUnit.summary: Orders an owned unit (such as the HQ drone) to move to target hex (q, r).

placeBuilding.summary: Queues construction of a structure at (q, r) and auto-links any missing site preparation ops (UO-TF-03).

reorderTask.summary: Reorders a player-queued entry within its lane (UO-P §4.4, W02-13).

setHarvestWeights.summary: Immediately updates the per-family harvest weights for standing Harvester jobs (UO-L-01, W02-12).

system.spawnColony.summary: Spawns a colony drop pod at a free spawn slot with starting pod cargo (W01-09).

brownout.summary: Emitted (debounced) when a colony power deficit causes brownout load shedding in `group` (W02-06, W02-17).

buildingCompleted.summary: Emitted when construction of a structure reaches 100 % completion (W01-16, W02-17, W02-28).

colonyFounded.summary: Emitted when a colony completes its Command Hub T1 and claims its initial territory (W01-17, W01-31).

dev.pong.summary: Emitted by the sim when a dev.ping command is applied.

energyCollapse.summary: Emitted when a colony remains in brownout for >= 30 s continuously (SIM §9, W02-06, W02-17).

hqLanded.summary: Emitted when the drop pod finishes its descent and deploys the HQ Commander drone (W01-09).

obstacleRemoved.summary: Emitted when a Forest or Rock obstacle is removed via Clear or Break (Stone Mason progression, W01-13, W01-31).

resourceProduced.summary: Aggregated per-60 s resource production batch emitted onto the event bus for Stockpile progression (W02-28).

resourceShortage.summary: Emitted when a resource drops below 5 % of its family cap with negative net flow over 60 s (SIM §9, W02-17).

tilePrepared.summary: Emitted when one or more tiles reach the Prepared state via Grade (Groundbreaker progression, W01-13, W01-31).

unitProduced.summary: Emitted when a worker or combat unit completes production and spawns at its producer edge (W02-10, W02-17).
